name: Six-stage loop vs spoken first audio (operator voice dead air)

A_real_six_stage_loop.statement: Every operator request must run a real PERCEIVE → RETRIEVE → PLAN → ACT → OBSERVE → LEARN loop. Skipping the brain for speed is forbidden.

B_spoken_progress.statement: Spoken operator turns must not go silent for seconds. Voice SLO P50 TTFA <500ms / P95 <800ms. If the loop takes ~5s, the operator should hear real, honest, incremental speech during that wait.

progressive_narration.what_it_is: Tool-execution narration on the Pipecat bridge only (narrate_tool_started / narrate_tool_completed from real tool SSE). Never fabricated filler. Does not narrate PERCEIVE/RETRIEVE/PLAN.
progressive_narration.http_talk: TTS is driven only by text-delta. voice.cognitive_loop and tool-input-available are metadata, not speech.
progressive_narration.operator_shaped_plan_turns: Typically no tool SSE before the answer, so even Pipecat would stay silent through the think gap.

close_only_after_named_choice: Speak honest loop-stage progress on the spoken path, derived from real loop state (not fabricated filler).
Make the six-stage loop fast enough that silence stays under the voice SLO.
Accept dead air as the explicit cost of a real loop (written product decision).
